## Checklist
- [ ] PR title uses Conventional Commits (`fix:`, `feat:`, `docs:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] The change is small and focused on one topic
- [ ] Tests added or updated (or not needed, with a reason)
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .` and `python -m pytest` pass (locally, or in the CI of this PR)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, internal names or private URLs in code, docs, logs or screenshots (this repository is public)
- [ ] Docs updated if needed (`README.md`, `DEVELOPER.md`, `params.cfg`)
- [ ] Other repositories checked: ChaBo-Deploy, ChaBo-ChatUI, instance-example
- [ ] Change documented in the private admin notes
- [ ] Security findings are NOT written here; they are reported privately
